mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS chunk_id, d.id AS document_id, dv.id AS document_version_id, d.display_name AS document_name, c.sequence_number, c.content, CAST(c.source_position AS text) AS source_position, 1 - (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector)) AS similarity FROM chunks c JOIN document_versions dv ON dv.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND dv.id = c.document_version_id JOIN documents d ON d.workspace_id = dv.workspace_id AND d.id = dv.document_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND d.current_version_id = dv.id AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL AND 1 - (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector)) >= #{minimumSimilarity} ORDER BY c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryEmbedding} AS vector), c.id LIMIT #{topK}
